title: Incorrect commit-loss when using `mask` in LFQ forward pass
author: nilq

comments.author: lucidrains
comments.body:

do you want to see if the latest commit fixes it?

comments.author: nilq
comments.body: Hey @lucidrains – that was quick! I have confirmed that the latest commit fixes the issue. I will close https://github.com/lucidrains/vector-quantize-pytorch/pull/189 as your fix is clearer.

comments.author: nilq
comments.body:
I was a bit too quick. It now breaks when not using a `mask` because `input_for_entropy` won't be defined.

Everything checks out when adding a fallback:
```py
if exists(mask):
    input_for_entropy = original_input[mask]
else:
    input_for_entropy = original_input
```
